findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/OrthogonalSpinGroups/README.md:574 names the dim-6 content as "`σ` sends `ω` to `-ω`". The sign is computed inline at Center.lean:56-57 and 85-87 but never stated; Spin/LowRank/Six.lean:131-132 and :176-177 re-derive `reverse (l.map (ι Q)).prod = -(l.map (ι Q)).prod` by hand.
findings.fix: Expose the characteristic action lemma: `reverseEven Q ⟨(l.map (ι Q)).prod, prod_map_ι_mem_even_of_even_length hlen⟩ = ((-1) ^ l.length.choose 2) • ⟨…⟩` (CommRing-level, immediate from `reverse_prod_map_ι_of_pairwise_isOrtho`), plus the coordinate form `a + b • ω ↦ a - b • ω` in the odd-sign case; derive the dimension-six existential from it or drop it.
findings.issue: No lemma gives the action of reversal on the centre: `exists_mem_center_reverseEven_ne_of_finrank_eq_six` is a witness-free existential (a one-line negation of `forall_reverseEven_eq_self_on_center_iff` at 6), and the docstring claim "reversal is conjugation on that quadratic algebra" is unsupported by any exposed declaration. A consumer cannot obtain `reverseEven ω = -ω` or `reverseEven (a + b • ω) = a - b • ω` without redoing the computation.

findings.evidence: Its companions at the identical generality are public: `Even/Center.lean:145 add_smul_volume_injective_of_even_length` and `Even/Center.lean:116 prod_map_ι_ne_algebraMap_of_even_length`. Its statement mentions only `reverse`, `algebraMap`, `ι`, `List` — no `even Q`, no centre.
findings.fix: Split off the general reversal-on-coordinates computation as a public lemma (CommRing, `namespace CliffordAlgebra`, this file or `Reversal/Basic.lean`) and derive the `b = 0` criterion from it; private is then unnecessary for the criterion too.
findings.issue: `private theorem reverse_fixed_volume_coordinates` hides a statement at the same level of generality as the public coordinate API it consumes, and bundles into one private step a computation (`reverse (algebraMap a + b • ω) = algebraMap a + ((-1) ^ (n.choose 2) * b) • ω`) that needs no field, no anisotropy and no centre.

findings.evidence: Line 129-130: hypotheses `(hQ : Q.Nondegenerate) (hV : finrank K V = 4) (hx : x ∈ Subalgebra.center K (even Q))`; plain `simp` does not use local hypotheses to discharge conditional rewrites, and `Q.Nondegenerate` / centre membership have no simp normal form.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]`; keep it as a plain theorem (consistent with the dimension-six sibling at line 137, which is not annotated).
findings.issue: `@[simp]` on `reverseEven_eq_self_of_mem_center_of_finrank_eq_four` is a wrong annotation: the LHS `reverseEven Q x` matches every reversal term, while the three side conditions `Q.Nondegenerate`, `finrank K V = 4` and `x ∈ Subalgebra.center K (even Q)` are not simp-dischargeable, so the rule costs failed discharge attempts on every `reverseEven` application and effectively never fires.

findings.evidence: `namespace CliffordAlgebra` in every neighbour: Reversal/Basic.lean:26, Reversal/Three.lean:24, Reversal/Four.lean:46, Reversal/Five.lean:49, Even/Center.lean:62. The bare-`TauCeti` files in this directory name new objects instead (RealForm/Four.lean:98 `realCliffordFourZeroEvenEquivQuaternionProd`).
findings.fix: Declare these in `namespace CliffordAlgebra` (or `TauCeti.CliffordAlgebra`, as `Even/Scaling.lean` does) and drop the `open _root_.CliffordAlgebra`.
findings.issue: The declarations land in bare `namespace TauCeti` although they are named in the `reverseEven_*` / `mem_center_even_*` nomenclature of `CliffordAlgebra`, so the public names are `TauCeti.reverseEven_eq_self_iff_of_mem_center` next to `CliffordAlgebra.reverseEven_mul`, splitting the reversal API across two namespaces.

summary: The file exposes fixed-point predicates but no lemma computing reversal's action on the centre, so the roadmap's dimension-six content ("σ sends ω to -ω") is only available as a witness-free existential and the general coordinate computation stays private. Also a non-firing `@[simp]` and a namespace inconsistent with every sibling reversal module.
